scientific_integrity: Mathematical proof supplied; finite enumerations are supporting examples and do not certify general novelty or infinite cases.
scientific_limitations: Theorem is restricted to characteristic two and radical-square-zero quiver algebras; reduced affine variety only. Unipotent 1+J rather than full-unit conjugacy. No higher Loewy length or scheme-theoretic nilpotents. Source inspections leave publication-priority risks; not independently validated.
title: Characteristic-two tripotent components and independent sets in radical-square-zero quiver algebras
